tabs.label: Sections
login.tagline: Your children's marks from the school diary: averages, filters, hints and notifications.
login.note: One parent connects the diary; everyone else signs in with an invite and their own login. Children never need the diary password.
login.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.error.diary_auth_failed: The diary did not accept this login and password.
auth.error.diary_blocked: The diary blocked this login. Check it in the diary itself.
auth.error.needs_2fa: The diary asks for a confirmation code; Marksy cannot enter one yet.
auth.error.already_connected: This diary is already connected to a family. Ask its admin for an invite.
auth.error.login_taken: This Marksy login is taken. Choose another one.
auth.error.diary_unavailable: The diary does not answer right now. Try again later.
auth.error.student_login_not_supported: A student's diary login is not supported yet: connect a parent's diary.
auth.error.invite_gone: This invite code does not work: it is wrong, used or expired.
connect.beta: This diary is supported in a test version: something may not work yet.
connect.marksyPassword.hint: not the one from the diary
connect.consent: The diary login and password are checked once, stored encrypted and used only to read the diary a few times a day on school days. Marksy never changes anything in the diary.
connect.otherCountry.sub: how to add your own diary
match.title: Diary connected
match.follow.text: Only the diary and what the child does in the app are shared: ready ticks, study time, subject colours and goals. Your members, tags, rules and notifications are yours, theirs are theirs. The other family gets one message, without names.
match.join.text: Its admin confirms the request, and you become a parent there: one family, shared tags and rules.
match.note: There is never a second copy of the child: the diary is read once for both families. Access comes from the diary itself: if your login stops showing the child, the child disappears here too.

fresh.refused: Data as of {{when}}. The diary did not accept the login; syncing has stopped.
